verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs describe the Console API as "the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI," which directly states API parity with the UI. A CLI for CI/CD management and an MCP server back this up. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, so the breadth of that parity rests on the vendor's claim alone. Missing for 10: endpoint-level evidence that every console action (e.g., access management, analytics, warehouse-native settings) is exposed, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
